title: Non-Profit Organisations (Accounting Requirements for Specified Classes) Order, 2025
text:
No. 30] Non-Profit Organisations 1
BELIZE:
STATUTORY INSTRUMENT
No. 30 of 2025
ORDER made by the Minister responsible for non-profit
organisations, on the recommendation of the Finan-
cial Services Commission, in exercise of the powers
conferred upon him by section 18 of the Non-Profit
Organisations Act, (Act No. 14 of 2023), and all other
powers thereunto him enabling.
(Gazetted 1st March, 2025)
1. This Order may be cited as the Citation.
NON-PROFIT ORGANISATIONS (ACCOUNTING
REQUIREMENTS FOR SPECIFIED CLASSES)
ORDER, 2025.
2. It is hereby specified that a NPO with annual cumulative Accounting
revenues or grants of $500,000.00 and above shall have their requirements.
accounts audited annually and submit a management letter
by an auditor approved under the Accountancy Profession CAP. 305.
Act.
MADE by the Minister responsible for non-profit organisations
on the recommendation of the Financial Services Commission
this 27th day of February, 2025.
HON. JOHN BRICEÑO
Prime Minister and Minister of Finance,
Economic Development and Investment,
Civil Aviation and Immigration
(Minister responsible for Non-Profit Organisations)
Printed in Belize by the Government Printer
#1 Power Lane, Belmopan
